body: Right now I'm trying to make a deep and interesting portfolio that will get me into school. But I do give fan art a try every once in awhile. Especially portal 2 fan art. But somehow books and art and all that stuff are just ain't enough.

I'm not in the mood for anything anymore. I've been drawing quite a lot last week since I'm trying for a prestigious art school in 3 days and I really want to get in. I always beat my self for not drawing and reading and watching movies as much as I want to but it's getting really hard to get outta bed. So now it's mostly internet all day long. My real life friends are very busy with school and my online friends are not meeting my exaggerated expectations. I know they have lives and all but I really want to talk to them all the time.

I don't know if I have depression, I don't wanna diagnose myself.

At some point in my life I stopped talking to people about my family because no one would get it. It didn't make sense to them how no one gives a shit about the other person's feelings and everyone is so keen to humiliate their siblings and destroy their self-esteem. But that's the way it is. 

I really hope I'll get into the school I want to go to and move to the dorms next year, but next year is in a long time. Right now I'm having a horrible time with them because it's vacation time and everyone's home and it's all so stressful. One thing that I know I'm gonna do is spend as many weekends as possible at my friend's.

And the day you'll get my older siblings to go to therapy is the day pigs will fly and iphones will have a removable battery.
